acceptanceCriteria: Failed git status yields nonzero refusal before ACK acceptance or completion, with original diagnostic retained.
A corrupt-index/unreviewed-source regression fails before repair and passes after repair; actual clean resume remains qualified.
Independent re-review and root integration evidence are retained; ticket remains open until native completion requirements succeed.
body: Independent review of unpublished candidate eaad98d663d11aa3dbcc3dbb1d04e87e8d3f9239 found script/proof-tour.sh:149 ignores the git status exit code. In isolated reproduction /private/tmp/proof-tour-review-status.dP05ML, a corrupt index plus an unreviewed source change emitted fatal Git diagnostics yet the tour completed with exit 0. Expected: failed inspection refuses and never attests clean worktree. This is a candidate defect, not a claim about installed Core 1.0.0-rc.1. Owning feature V1-0504, root integration V1-0516.

completion.reason: Already fixed on main before this re-verification, by d2425f7f (reject failed tour status reads) and 9e44e5fd (retain proof-tour Git status diagnostics), under PT-V0-004 and PT-V0-007 in docs/specs/proof-tour-v0.md. Re-verified on 2026-10-08 at main 2a93b5a182966f72836cd28bf569dc44c0f5220c: script/proof-tour-test.sh exits 0, including the corrupt-index, corrupt-index-retry and status-diagnostic-retained cases; the same test against the pre-fix script (2fd500a9) fails with status-failure-accepted-as-clean. Ticket scenario (corrupt .git/index, an unreviewed edit, a mock ACCEPT ACK): the pre-fix script exits 0 outcome=complete; current main exits 3 reason=git-status-failed before ACK validation, keeping git's exit 128 and its diagnostic; a clean resume still completes. Independent Codex review: no P0-P2 findings. Evidence digests are the sha256 of the four cited files at that commit. NOT_RUN: make gate, and a rerun of a real independently acknowledged tour (the mock ACK is not independent-review qualification). NOT_PRODUCED: new CEM, because no source changed. Manual completion because the repair predates this ticket's re-verification.

title: Proof tour must refuse failed Git status before accepting a clean fixture
